guidance.said: The company is on track to complete nearly INR25,000 crores of capex for the year.
guidance.quote: And we have already done INR10,000 crores of capex, and we are on track to complete nearly INR25,000 crores of capex for the year.
guidance.speaker: Praveer Sinha

guidance.said: The company's capacity addition target is 2.5 GW for the year.
guidance.quote: So, we expect that this year target is 2.5 GW of capacity addition, and we will be able to meet that.
guidance.speaker: Praveer Sinha

reported.quote: We have reported our highest-ever quarterly profit after tax of INR1,652 crores, which is an increase of 33% year-on-year compared to INR1,245 crores in the corresponding period last year.
We also see that our revenues have gone up by nearly 26% in the quarter from INR19,886 crores from INR15,769 crores.
The PAT has gone up to INR3,053 crores, 22% more than last year.
The revenue has gone up to INR38,784 crores from INR33,233 crores in the previous year.
The EBITDA has gone up by 7% to INR8,494 crores from INR7,961 crores.

business: Tata Power Company Ltd operates across power generation, transmission, distribution, and renewable energy segments. It engages in utility-scale and rooftop solar, solar manufacturing, pump hydro projects, and power distribution through various DISCOMs.
